newsitem.title: USA: AMR agrees to buy 103 Boeing jetliners.
newsitem.headline: AMR agrees to buy 103 Boeing jetliners.

text.p: American Airlines said on Thursday that it agreed to buy 103 airliners from Boeing Co. in a major victory for the world's biggest commercial airplane manufacturer.

The airline, a subsidiary of AMR Corp., said it would purchase 103 Boeing jets and had the rights to buy as many as 527 more. Based on list prices, the 103-plane purchase would be worth more than $6 billion.
Dallas-based American, the second-largest U.S. airline, also said that Seattle-based Boeing would be its exclusive aircraft supplier through the year 2018.
